notes.title: The Ghost of Alcantra is in the Fall In Love Steam Festival! + A Special Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, Nick here. I have two pieces of exciting news for you all. First and most importantly, We are a part of the Fall in Love Steam Festival! Our game, along with over 200 others are a part of the festival. Please check us out if you have not already, and check out the other fantastic romance visual novels participating.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/d70fee97076d3adeabd7526c375ffb1cf91a9a51.png"][/img][/p][p]To celebrate the festival, we are adding [b]additional content [/b]to The Ghost of Alcantra! These are bonus scenes that will unlock as you read the story (don't worry if you have read the story already, the scenes will unlock on their own if you have played though the game). We have 5 of them for now, but we plan on adding more in the future that will tie into our other planned works that also take place in the same world as The Ghost of Alcantra![/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye out for people streaming our game during the fest, and in particular, keep an eye out for [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/cremestrawbun"][/dynamiclink] and  [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/ecrivaiin"][/dynamiclink] as we will be joining their streams the today at 5pm CST and 27th at 3pm CST respectively to talk a bit about The Ghost of Alcantra![/p][p][/p][p]Here is a link to the fest itself:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/studioelan/sale/fallinlovefestival2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/studioelan/sale/fallinlovefestival2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/bccd5e9592aa189daee093c39231e31218417de6.png"][/img][/p][p]Nick[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update for The Ghost of Alcantra!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, Nick here. It's been almost two months since we released The Ghost of Alcantra. A huge thank you to everyone who has read our work so far. Your positive feedback has been heartwarming to see. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/6d8201d1c5120807a5bdf9695787fd1cb4e7d6e3.png"][/img][/p][p]This weekend is actually a special one for us. In our hometown of Houghton Michigan, it is Bridge Fest, which was the direct inspiration for the Summer Festival used in The Ghost of Alcantra. In fact, the background images used during the first scene were all taken during Bridge Fest. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/47a396a83664d0d62deddde5a018e46c405be1fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we have a content update for you all! The Ghost of Alcantra now has a replay feature. Now, every time the date changes in game, it unlocks that scene in the Replay Library. Unfortunately, this will not work retroactively, so scenes witnessed before the update will need to be viewed again before unlocking. We also addressed some minor script errors while we were at it. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/bccd5e9592aa189daee093c39231e31218417de6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Nick[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. We at ACatBox Productions have started work on our next Visual Novel! We have big things planned for this one. I won’t get into the details here, as we are still in the script revision/ directorial comment stage. However, we will hopefully have more details to show sometime in the near future. Follow us on our socials for future updates![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Ghost of Alcantra Releases in 3 Days!
notes.content:
Hello again, Nick here. 3 Days to go! The final countdown. I will share another list of facts today, this time on name inspirations.

1.  Nick Fox is named after two people, Nick's origin comes from myself and Fox comes from another friend of ours. 

2. Detective Kyle Rage was named Kyle because we have two friends named Kyle. 

3. Alexandria was picked because of the similarity Colin's sister’s name.

Look forward to tomorrows post, where we will be discussing music. 

Until next time,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/bccd5e9592aa189daee093c39231e31218417de6.png[/img]

Nick

notes.title: The Ghost of Alcantra Releases in 5 days!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, Nick here again. 5 days remain before The Ghost of Alcantra releases. Today's fun fact is less of a discussion on something on the creation process, and more of some interesting facts about when and how we worked on The Ghost of Alcantra.

1. This story was written part-time and as such, most of The Ghost of Alcantra was written between midnight and 4 in the morning.

2. A Mountain Dew was drank for every writing session, meaning, around 70 Mountain Dews were drank during the writing of this.

3. I did not burn the midnight oil to program myself, instead working during the evenings after work and during the day on Sundays. According to my timetable, ~265 hours were spent putting the first draft into engine. 

4. Instead of Mountain Dew, I allowed myself a glass of whisky on my particularly long Friday programming sessions. 

5. Colin and I have spent well over 100 hours in a call together discussing revisions to the script and engine presentation. 

Until next time,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578600/bccd5e9592aa189daee093c39231e31218417de6.png[/img]

Nick
